notes: METHOD: WebSearch/WebFetch plus plain curl, only on pages whose robots.txt allowed it; sites that block AI crawlers or return 403/429 were not read (actonclimatevt.org, t4vt.org, vctn.org, hungerfreevt.org, marshfieldvt.gov, addisonindependent.com, hinesburgrecord.org, citizenportal.ai, wcax.com, vermontpublic.org, vippahydro.org, thetfordvt.gov, stowevt.gov pages, efficiencyvermont.com, veic.org, driveelectricvt.com).
